title: Certify Int lemmas of the nonlinear solver by polynomial refutations
summary: Clauses that hold by what a product of Int terms means, such as lemmas of Z3's nonlinear solver, are now certified: the pipeline finds a polynomial refutation of the literals and Lean proves the clause from it. On the nonlinear corpus 24 of 78 unsat queries verify in Lean, up from 14.
